messages:
jess: Legal sent another DSAR variant asking for cryptographic proof of deletion for an old volume snapshot (snap-20240212). They specifically ask we show key-material inaccessibility, not just object delete.
legal-bot: DSAR-612 created by requester@external.org — response due 30d. Requested artifacts: deletion logs, KMS key version state, IAM policy at time of access.
omar: quick note: the snapshot was replicated cross-project to `eu-backups` for DR. those copies were encrypted with a CMEK in project `redwood-keystore-eu`. that complicates key proof because we have two keyrings and a rewrap plan in 2024-07.
rita: timeline we need: who created snapshot, who copied it, when it was deleted (if at all), and whether any key-version was disabled or destroyed. Also need to show chain-of-custody for exported logs.
sec-bot: Forensics checklist: export logs -> seal (sha256) -> store in evidence bucket -> record in legal case tracker.
omar: can we avoid destructive actions? legal usually accepts a combination of: export of KMS audit entries showing `cryptoKeyVersions.disable`/`destroy` calls (if any), and an exported key metadata snapshot showing current version states. If we destroy versions we lose ability to decrypt for other investigations.
jess: preference is non-destructive. plan: 1) confirm object-level deletes across all replicated buckets 2) export KMS audit entries for both keyrings 3) export IAM snapshot history for 24 months 4) produce a signed bundle (sha256 + signed by sec-pgp) and include in DSAR reply.
infra-bot: Retention note: cloud logging default retention 365d in prod, archived exports stored indefinitely at gs://infra-log-archive/. Ensure export window captured.
rita: RBAC question: who could have performed a cross-project copy or deletion? need list of principals with `roles/storage.objectAdmin` or perms including `storage.objects.copy`/`delete`. we recently added `incidents-admin@` group to project `infra` with elevated perms; check that.
omar: pulling IAM snapshots from infra-policy-archive now. command: ```bash
gsutil ls gs://infra-policy-archive/2023-*/policy.json
```
rita: good. also run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json` for the month of Feb-2024 from archive.
jess: export commands I'm running: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND protoPayload.methodName:("storage.objects.delete" OR "storage.objects.copy" OR "storage.objects.get") AND resource.labels.bucket_name:("snapshots" OR "snapshots-eu")' --start-time="2024-02-10T00:00:00Z" --end-time="2024-02-20T23:59:59Z" --format=json > /tmp/dsar612_gcs.json
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR resource.type="gce_instance"' --limit 10
```
jess: will then tar + compute sha256 and upload to gs://evidence-dsar-612/ and put hash in secure vault.
sec-bot: Reminder: put restrictive ACLs on evidence bucket: legal@redwood.com, sec@redwood.com, auditaudit@redwood.com only.
omar: KMS audit pull: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_crypto_key_version" AND protoPayload.methodName:("google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.DestroyCryptoKeyVersion" OR "DisableCryptoKeyVersion")' --start-time="2023-12-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time="2024-12-01T00:00:00Z" --format=json > /tmp/dsar612_kms.json
```
rita: cross-project twist: for EU copy the key is in `redwood-keystore-eu`. we need IAM binding snapshots for that project too.
jess: RBAC mitigation while we triage: propose we create a short-lived `forensics-lockdown` group with read-only on buckets and grant to named investigators. Open PR labeled `security/dsar-612-lockdown`.
om ar: +1. ensure change request references DSAR-612 and incident tags if any. infra-bot: Any IAM policy change will itself be logged; include those audit entries in the bundle.
legal-bot: DSAR-612 update: hold=false currently. If incident relationship discovered, legal will request hold and notify team.
jess: note — if hold is requested it supersedes deletion. for now proceed with exports but do not delete any object. mark snapshot objects with metadata `evidence.dsar=612` to avoid accidental purge. command: `gsutil label ch -l evidence=dsar-612 gs://snapshots/snap-20240212.img`
omar: exported artifacts uploaded to gs://evidence-dsar-612/ with ACLs set. sha256: `b6a9f6c8d4e3f1a2b3c4d5e6f7890abc1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef` (full hash in vault).
rita: added redacted audit snippet to thread: 
```json
{"protoPayload": {"methodName": "storage.objects.copy", "authenticationInfo": {"principalEmail": "snapshot-mirror@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}, "resourceName": "projects/_/buckets/snapshots-eu/objects/snap-20240212.img"}}
```
jess: PR created: #1502 `security: DSAR-612 forensics lockdown` reviewers: rita, omar, legal. tags: dsar-612, compliance.
omar: next steps checklist:
- [ ] collect GCS audit slice and KMS audit slice for 2024-02-01..2024-02-28
- [ ] collect IAM snapshots for redwood-prod & redwood-keystore-eu for 2023-11..2024-03
- [ ] PGP-sign and sha256 seal artifacts, upload to evidence bucket with strict ACL
- [ ] if incident link found, apply legal hold and notify infra to suspend purge jobs
- [ ] draft DSAR response referencing sealed artifacts and include proof of chain-of-custody

rita: I'll run the IAM exports and attach in thread. ETA 3h. jess/omar: flag if legal asks for destructive key actions; we will avoid destroying versions unless instructed by legal with full approvals.
sec-bot: Logged action: evidence bundle created (partial). Case DSAR-612 updated.
jess: thanks team. keep updates short; legal wants an initial status update by 2024-11-06 16:00 UTC.
infra-bot: Note: archival export contains full payloads — ensure PI is redacted before sending outside legal.
